svg.title: Who has the ball? Possession decoded frame by frame
svg.desc: A synthetic eleven-a-side play: control within 1.5 m, a touch that does not change possession, an interception that does, the ball lost by the tracker while possession is held, the ball going out for a dead ball, and the throw-in restart. The timeline is the output of possession.decoder on this play.
svg.text: Who has the ball? — decoded frame by frame
